patch.role: Rewrites the marker with a plain apostrophe; not the configured opening quote.

rationale: A substitutes the smart-quote opening quote for every `` marker. The candidate patch substitutes a plain apostrophe and is inert when A has already consumed every marker: with A present the guard is false, but with A removed the text differs from A's. Neither the patch nor its absence reproduces A, so no masking relation exists.
